q: If medical inflation runs 2 points higher, what happens to FY2027 margin?

r.response: If medical inflation runs 2 points higher (8.8% instead of 6.8%), FY2027 underlying profit falls by about GBP 35M — from GBP 367M to GBP 332M, and the margin from 9.6% to 8.7% (model). Combined with weaker member growth, a lower achieved premium rate and more agency use (the full downside scenario), the hit is about GBP 59M and the margin drops to 8.3%, below the 9% floor. Claims hit before premiums can be repriced at renewal, which is why this is the largest single risk in the plan.
